cards.front: An adequate response to treatment of early syphilis is a [___] fall in RPR titre from the baseline taken on the day of treatment.
cards.context:
The RPR can rise between diagnosis and treatment, so it is repeated on the day treatment starts. It is rechecked at 3, 6 and, if needed, 12 months.

A titre that has not fallen fourfold by 12 months needs specialist advice.

cards.front: Ultrasound is not used to diagnose PCOS until [___] after menarche.
cards.context:
Multifollicular ovaries are normal in the years after menarche, so ultrasound overcalls PCOS in adolescents.

In this age group the diagnosis needs both irregular cycles and hyperandrogenism.
